answer.text: Erodes real purchasing power; affects all assets including cash

explanation.text: The Logic: Inflation erodes real returns. Cash, bonds suffer; equity often hedges long-term (not short-term). The Trap: All asset classes impacted differently. Cross-Exam Context: X-A, XVII. Manager's Pro-Tip: Use inflation-linked bonds (IIBs) or equity/real estate for long-term inflation hedging.
